ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a diagram of the developmental stages of a grasshopper (grasshopper/locust). Next to the adult at the top is labeled with the letter F, and the arrow of F points to the long and narrow, layered structure extending along the body on the back of the adult. Reasoning: On the back of an adult grasshopper, this long strip-like structure covering the upper part of the body is wings. Therefore F represents wings.
